speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Measles (Rubeola).

The combination of fever, rhinorrhea, and a maculopapular rash spreading from the face downward while sparing the perioral area is the classic presentation of measles. I will stop asking questions to confirm this diagnosis based on the clinical evidence provided.
